criteria.criterion: Fund a community impact fund with a total commitment of $150 million for the HRMP project over the license term
required_elements: HRMP committed or is obligated to provide funding for a community impact fund
the total committed amount is $150 million
the commitment is for the HRMP project
the funding term is over a 30-year license term
criteria.promise_scope: HRMP / the Applicant promised a community impact fund for the project, totaling $150 million, to benefit community recipients through that fund; location is the project community as described in the application materials, but no narrower place is stated in the quoted promise passage; the quoted term says the commitment runs over a 30-year license term.
criteria.observed_scope: Delivery for the promised scope remains unverified.
criteria.explanation: The cited sources document the terms of the undertaking.
criteria.gap: The sources do not establish actual performance for the promised scope. Timing to verify: Over a 30-year license term.

Fund a community impact fund with a total commitment of $150 million for the HRMP project over the license term
Status: UNVERIFIED
The cited sources document the terms of the undertaking.
Promised scope: HRMP / the Applicant promised a community impact fund for the project, totaling $150 million, to benefit community recipients through that fund; location is the project community as described in the application materials, but no narrower place is stated in the quoted promise passage; the quoted term says the commitment runs over a 30-year license term.
Observed scope: Delivery for the promised scope remains unverified.
Evidence gap: The sources do not establish actual performance for the promised scope. Timing to verify: Over a 30-year license term.
Promise evidence: c1, c2

Cited source excerpts (promise, delivery, or context as assessed above):
c1: “As the Board previously noted, the project includes $761 million in community benefits as part of the project cost. Another $150 million has been proposed in ongoing commitments to a community impact fund, as the table below illustrates. The Applicant committed to this $150 million over a 30-year license term.”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2026/03/12.01.25.gflbselectiondocument1.pdf

c2: “As the Board previously noted, the project includes $761 million in community benefits as part of the project cost. Another $150 million has been proposed in ongoing commitments to a community impact fund, as the table below illustrates. The Applicant committed to this $150 million over a 30-year license term.”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2026/03/03.23.26.gflbreport.pdf

c3: “The Community Impact Fund, as proposed in the Application, is valued at $163 million over the 30-year length of the license. Our commitments will be binding under the gaming license, ensuring accountability and delivery.”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/final-cac-question-responses-9-19-25-redacted-c-1.pdf

c4: “The Fund is structured for annual disbursements, guaranteeing stable support for nonprofits, parks, and cultural institutions.”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/final-cac-question-responses-9-19-25-redacted-c-1.pdf

c5: “There is another $25 million dedicated to three neighborhood projects: East Elmhurst health clinic, Corona/Jackson Heights senior/youth center, and Flushing addiction services. There are also individual philanthropic commitments totaling approximately $2 million”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/final-cac-question-responses-9-19-25-redacted-c-1.pdf

c6: “Chart 5: HRMP Community Benefit during their 20-year Term of License”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2026/03/03.23.26.gflbreport.pdf

c7: “Community Impact Fund 13 150 163”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2026/03/03.23.26.gflbreport.pdf
